generous_rationale: Specific software, public-interest context, concrete defect claim and an admission by the manufacturer. Clean, restrained and newsy.

generous_rationale: Strong FTM headline: actors, action, money, opacity and Commission permission are all visible in one clear sentence.

title: After calling for change, right-wing parties oppose a more transparent EU
strict_rationale: The political reversal is clear and readable, but 'change' and 'a more transparent EU' are somewhat abstract.
generous_rationale: The actor and opposition are clear, and transparency is an accountability issue, but ‘change’ and ‘a more transparent EU’ are abstract.

title: For forty years, Viktor Orbán has thrived on conflict. Now he’s bringing the battle to Brussels

title: Extreme right or just extremely conservative? How Italy’s Meloni is playing both sides

title: Geert Wilders reaches peak of his power in the Netherlands – is Europe next?
strict_rationale: The power theme is relevant, but 'is Europe next?' turns it into speculative teaser language rather than a concrete claim.
generous_rationale: Strong political-power hook and good rhythm, but ‘is Europe next?’ turns it speculative and slightly clickbaity.

title: The donors behind almost three quarters of political donations in the EU are hidden from the public. Germany's to blame for most of it.

title: Luxury brand Gucci became ‘sustainable’ - by cooking the books

title: Fashion brands set to fail their own climate goals as overproduction fuels emissions, analysis shows

title: Microsoft uses carbon-offsetting scheme with no measurable impact
strict_rationale: Concise and concrete: Microsoft, the offsetting scheme and the measurable-impact claim are all visible and restrained.
generous_rationale: Compact and direct: named company, action, scheme and accountability-relevant consequence are all visible.

generous_rationale: Excellent standalone headline: public money, two clear actors, concrete actions, and a stark consequence. The short second sentence gives it force without becoming clickbait.

title: Can the carbon credits market be trusted to fix its own failings?

strict_rationale: Mostly a metaphorical topic label plus abstract assessment; it lacks a visible actor, action or concrete consequence.

strict_rationale: The policy conflict is relevant and attributed, but the first half is a generic label and the wording is bureaucratic.

strict_rationale: Energetic and actor-driven, with clear institutional conflict, but “crashed” is vivid rather than precise.

title: Christian Democrats break election promise to sideline far right in European Parliament
strict_rationale: Direct, concrete and politically consequential, with a clear actor, action and institutional setting.
